_comment: Real-model LineageBench v0 ground truth. Positives are Hub models whose parentage is corroborated by the publishing org's own documentation, not just the self-reported base_model tag (the whole premise of modeldna is that the tag alone isn't proof). 'parents' are foundation bases already in the seed reference DB (the SEED_MODELS list); real_lineagebench.py copies them from the local DB (no re-fetch) and pulls the 'pairs' suspects fresh from the Hub. This is a deliberately smaller, honestly-scoped slice of the eventual >=300-pair target -- see README for the full-scale roadmap.

DARE-TIES merge of NeuralMonarch/Monarch-lineage Mistral fine-tunes (mlabonne model card); every ancestor traces to mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1, so ground truth is a single foundation parent, not a cross-family merge -- tests that the tool attributes a merge-of-finetunes to its one true root instead of manufacturing a LIKELY_MERGE split.

SOLAR paper (arXiv:2312.15166): depth up-scaling duplicates a 32-layer Mistral-based model to 48 layers. Documented modeldna limitation (README): layer-count mismatch is detected and reported, not resolved, so this is expected to abstain rather than land in the AUROC positive pool.

TheBloke's GPTQ 4-bit quantization of mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1. GPTQ packs weights into int32 qweight/qzeros/scales tensors with different shapes than the fp16 original, outside the safetensors-only, shape-matched comparison this tool does today -- reported as a documented limitation, not scored in the AUROC pool.
